target_protein: OAT; PyrK; LDH; SpdSyn; SAMS; plasmepsins I/II; MSP1; actin
assay_or_method: activity-based chemical proteomics plus orthogonal validation
result: 124 covalent binding targets were reported and selected targets showed binding-associated functional impairment
host_selectivity_or_control: healthy RBC proteins were not labeled under reported conditions
inference_boundary: proteome target list is assay- and probe-dependent; does not exclude noncovalent targets

assay_or_method: cellular resistance genetics plus immunopurified enzyme assay
result: DHA inhibited immunopurified PfPI3K at 4 nM and PfK13 C580Y was associated with increased PfPI3K/PI3P
host_selectivity_or_control: 46 mammalian kinases including VPS34 were not significantly inhibited at 10 uM
inference_boundary: mechanistic anchor but not proof that PfPI3K is the sole lethal target

assay_or_method: chemical-genetic and proteostasis assays
result: DHA caused protein damage and compromised proteasome function with accumulation of damaged and polyubiquitinated proteins
host_selectivity_or_control: proteasome inhibitors and stress-response controls were used
inference_boundary: proteasome involvement does not identify one direct DHA-binding subunit

assay_or_method: photoaffinity chemical proteomics and target validation
result: stage-specific target sets implicated protein synthesis glycolysis and oxidative homeostasis
host_selectivity_or_control: stage-resolved parasite experiments
inference_boundary: reported target associations are broader than validated direct biochemical interactions

target_protein: Lm PTR1; Lm CS; Ld NMT; Lm TryS
assay_or_method: molecular docking of 123 sesquiterpene-related compounds
result: compound 75/76 xanthanolides had predicted Lm PTR1 affinity of -10.6 kcal/mol; structural contacts were proposed
host_selectivity_or_control: not a host selectivity experiment
inference_boundary: docking scores are hypotheses and the compounds are not established here as Artemisia constituents

assay_or_method: in silico pharmacophore/docking plus spectrophotometric recombinant-enzyme assays
result: cnicin inhibited Tb PTR1 with EC50 21.2 uM; cynaropicrin inhibited Tb PTR1 12.4 uM and Tb DHFR 7.1 uM
host_selectivity_or_control: enzyme assays lacked a mammalian homolog selectivity panel in this record
inference_boundary: validates enzyme inhibition for tested compounds but does not establish Artemisia origin or whole-parasite target engagement

assay_or_method: molecular docking analysis
result: hydrophobic active-site pocket interactions were proposed for terpenoids including beta-caryophyllene and germacrene D
host_selectivity_or_control: prior enzyme activity context was not an Artemisia-specific matched experiment
inference_boundary: contextual target hypothesis only; no direct binding or parasite efficacy is assigned here

assay_or_method: surface plasmon resonance, mass spectrometry, and crystallographic mapping
result: binding regions adjacent to residues 19-46 108-134 and 140-163 were reported
host_selectivity_or_control: host selectivity not resolved in this record
inference_boundary: direct binding is supported but its contribution to parasite killing remains unresolved

assay_or_method: cryo-EM plus MS-CETSA and parasite structural analysis
result: artemisinin treatment increased the population of Pf80S ribosomes bound by PfRACK1
host_selectivity_or_control: study addresses parasite complexes rather than a mammalian homolog counterscreen
inference_boundary: complex stabilization likely contributes to action but is not a purified artemisinin-PfRACK1 affinity measurement or sole-mechanism proof

assay_or_method: whole extract/oil parasite assays
result: anthelmintic phenotypes are present in the Artemisia literature but no parasite protein interaction is resolved in this map
host_selectivity_or_control: host-control varies by study
inference_boundary: protein target discovery remains an explicit gap requiring fractionation and target assays

stage_or_model: Xenopus oocyte expression and parasite imaging
assay_or_method: oocyte transport assay competition imaging and iron-dependence experiments
result: artemisinins inhibited PfATP6 while desoxyartemisinin was inactive and thapsigargin antagonized parasite killing
host_selectivity_or_control: quinine and chloroquine controls were inactive in the PfATP6 assay
inference_boundary: functional evidence supports PfATP6 involvement but later multi-target evidence precludes a sole-target interpretation

assay_or_method: molecular docking
result: -6.25 kcal/mol predicted affinity
host_selectivity_or_control: fenbendazole and untreated controls in associated extract assay
inference_boundary: docking does not establish binding, target engagement, terpene abundance, or causal contribution to extract anthelmintic activity

assay_or_method: molecular docking
result: -6.90 kcal/mol predicted affinity
host_selectivity_or_control: fenbendazole and untreated controls in associated extract assay
inference_boundary: docking does not establish binding, target engagement, terpene abundance, or causal contribution to extract anthelmintic activity

assay_or_method: heterologous yeast complementation plus parasite calcium imaging and secretion assays
result: artemisinin inhibited recombinant TgSERCA-associated activity and triggered calcium-dependent microneme secretion and calcium perturbation
host_selectivity_or_control: thapsigargin comparator and calcium imaging controls
inference_boundary: supports a Ca2+-ATPase target class but is not direct purified artemisinin affinity or proof of sole parasite mechanism

assay_or_method: bioassay-guided fractionation and stage-resolved parasite assay
result: isolated guaianolide compounds were principal components responsible for A. afra gametocytocidal activity; one compound also inhibited asexual parasites in vitro
host_selectivity_or_control: parasite stage controls and extract/fraction comparisons
inference_boundary: constituent-to-phenotype evidence is stronger than crude extract but target protein and in-vivo transmission impact remain unresolved

compound_or_chemotype: apigenin and A. absinthium phenolic profile
assay_or_method: HPLC profiling plus molecular docking and molecular dynamics
result: apigenin was the top predicted ligand at -9.6 kcal/mol; no direct enzyme or parasite binding assay was reported
host_selectivity_or_control: absent in-vitro enzyme and host-selectivity validation
inference_boundary: docking does not establish binding or target engagement; apigenin is non-terpene and this record is not evidence for a wormwood terpene mechanism

assay_or_method: matched oxidative-stress RBC pretreatment plus drug-susceptibility assays
result: oxidative-stress exposure reduced artemisinin and DHA efficacy and implicated parasite stress-response pathways
host_selectivity_or_control: untreated RBC controls and selected parasite mutants
inference_boundary: supports a dynamic parasite-state modifier rather than direct protein binding; does not establish a plant-chemotype effect or sole resistance target

stage_or_model: early rings and asexual blood stages
assay_or_method: chemical-genetic proteostasis assays with Kelch13 and 19S/20S proteasome mutants
result: UPR signaling and proteasome function determined DHA survival outcomes; proteasome perturbation increased susceptibility independent of Kelch13 genotype
host_selectivity_or_control: parental/mutant parasite comparisons and proteostasis readouts
inference_boundary: supports a resistance-relevant target class and dynamic state; not a purified direct DHA-proteasome affinity measurement

target_protein: redox-related parasite proteins and glutathione-redox homeostasis
interaction_mode: chemoproteomic labeling plus functional redox perturbation
assay_or_method: activity-based chemoproteomics with live redox biosensor and thiol metabolomics
result: peroxide probes showed enrichment of redox-related proteins and disrupted parasite redox homeostasis
host_selectivity_or_control: probe controls; infected/uninfected and treated comparisons
inference_boundary: supports a target class and cellular mechanism; enrichment does not establish one direct protein target or a plant-chemotype effect

artemisia_context: A. douglasiana-associated and Asteraceae sesquiterpene lactones
assay_or_method: glutathione rescue, intracellular glutathione assay, and ROS fluorescence
result: reduced glutathione blocked or reversed the growth effect of DhL, Mxc, and Psi; active compounds depleted parasite glutathione and increased ROS 2.7- to 5.4-fold
host_selectivity_or_control: DMSO, H2O2, three-experiment, and ANOVA/Dunnett controls
inference_boundary: supports a functional parasite redox target class but not a single protein, direct binding, intracellular-stage efficacy, or transfer to A. absinthium
